This assessment does not establish the surrounding claims about token-budget accuracy or a required sample count.
limitations: The decisive study is a preprint covering selected models and code-review tasks.
It did not test a literal Claude.MD file or every current agent workflow.
The study's exact experiment dates are unspecified; its results were public in February 2025.
Observed variability does not by itself establish unpredictable costs or unsuccessful task completion.
